cartoes.dica: The {{total}} Ultra Blue cards are hidden in objects and people, in new places every time the game opens. Get close and press A to search.
cartoes.concluido: You found all the Ultra Blue cards in {{tempo}}. Congratulations!

rici.descricao: Leads Fernanda, Fábio, Garba, André Roxa, Andrea and Roman, and with them the whole UX team. Brings BTG, Pan and Mobiauto into one way of doing design. Clears the path for the team to deliver.

garba.descricao: Runs Vehicles, today the bank's most profitable product, with recognized market share and leadership in financing fronts. Already R$ 2 bn above this year's target.

rogerio.descricao: Took on the most complex journeys of the year, like agnostic Portability. Brings AI into the UX process with a kickoff agent. Also shipped the Payroll Endorsement Consent.

fernanda.descricao: R$ 10.81 bn in production in Payroll Loans UX, 82.5% of the vertical. Moved the journeys to White Label without stopping the current app. Leads Igor, Denise, Renan and Rogério.

dea.descricao: Committed and proactive, she is never late. Has a great relationship with every team and is praised by the BTG Cash team.

roman.descricao: Committed and collaborative, he takes a product from scratch, bringing every team together. Gets great feedback from the Vehicles team.

entregas.provisorio: Content coming soon: this board's deliveries will be posted here.

slides.01-bob-credit-risk-platform: Bruno Bob Silva, Credit Risk Platform: credit risk analysis management, 5 systems unified and R$ 360 bn in approved credit limits. Beside it, the platform home screen on a laptop.
slides.02-filipe-renegocie: Filipe Neves, Renegocie: redesign of the renegotiation journey, 96 thousand monthly visitors on average, 154 thousand confirmed agreements and 351.6 million renegotiated. Beside it, the agreement screens on a phone and a laptop.
slides.03-ju-tyr: Juliana Mota, Tyr: credit policy management, more visibility and autonomy for Business and time savings for IT, and complex policies simplified into self-explanatory interfaces. Beside it, a policy decision flow on a laptop.
slides.04-wes-elos: Wesley Santos, ELOS: unification of the systems used by the bank legal team, over 254 thousand cases registered and over 569 thousand tasks created. Beside it, a case screen on a laptop.
slides.05-pedro-reits: Pedro Magalhães, Reits: modernization of the real estate fund (FII) system, leader in FII administration since 2012, an R$ 200 bn FII market with over 430 funds, and 275 funds administered by BTG. Beside it, the payment settlement screen on a laptop.
slides.06-fernando-market-solutions: Fernando Seleghini, Market Solutions: Investor Relations and Bookkeeping portals unified, over 215 clients, R$ 45 million in annual revenue and 5.9 thousand monthly visitors on average. Beside it, the quote and shareholder dashboard on a laptop.
slides.07-bruno-muniz-salesforce: Bruno Muniz, Salesforce for Partners: review and evolution of the Salesforce experience for Partners, and improvements to Operational Flow, Call to Action and the Relationship Cadence. Beside it, the CRM home screen on a laptop.
slides.08-renan-marcal-fts: Renan Marçal, FTS for Luxembourg: design of the booked credit journeys for Luxembourg, bringing credit, collateral and approval into a single view to simplify reconciliation. Beside it, the commitments screen on a laptop.
slides.09-jeniffer-paiva-less: Jeniffer Nath Paiva, LESS: Onboarding system redesign, 60% to 80% less effort to open accounts and configure them, and impact on 2 thousand daily users (BPOs and internal BTG Pactual teams). Beside it, the powers configuration screen on a laptop.

slides.01-andrea-borba-gopan: Andrea Borba, go!PAN: simulation with transparent insurance, award-winning application form, go!PAN commercial (moving off NPV), dealer autonomy and the PanOnline shutdown. Beside it, the GoPAN Veículos new proposal screen on a laptop.
slides.02-roman-financiamento-c2c: Roman, C2C Financing: journey and tests for a new product, Credit Letter and AutoPAN with change, insurance in the Formalizer, Pix and balance in after-sales, Vehicles Home and Move Brasil. Beside it, three app screens with the financing offer.

selecao.dica: Arrows or tap to choose, A or Enter to play. Whoever you skip walks around the map.
selecao.dicaTroca: You stay in the same spot, with your cards and time. Whoever leaves walks the map where the new one was.
